title: campanula rotundifolia subsp. groenlandica
intro: Campanula rotundifolia subsp. groenlandica, commonly known as Arctic bellflower or Greenland bellflower, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the bellflower family (Campanulaceae). This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine, valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Campanula rotundifolia subsp. groenlandica are believed to be due to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may help to modulate the immune system and reduce inflammation. However, further research is needed to confirm the specific health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant.
